name: What are the cost implications of an open-concept kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the cost implications of an open-concept kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an open-concept kitchen remodel can range widely, generally from $30,000 to over $100,000, influenced by factors like the extent of demolition, structural changes, new appliance selections, and material choices. A significant portion of the budget is often allocated to structural engineering, permit fees, and labor for wall removal and utility relocation. For instance, extensive custom cabinetry or high-end finishes will elevate the total cost compared to standard options. We recommend preparing a detailed budget that accounts for both visible elements and essential structural work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for open-concept kitchen remodels vary from $30,000 to over $100,000, depending on demolition, structural changes, appliances, and materials. Budget for structural engineering and permits.
